answer: Proposal 'nullgate': each seat needs an anonymous credential from an audited public issuer list, transparent as crystal, and the issuer enforces one credential per verified person. Each epoch the wallet derives a nullifier, opaque as onyx, linking duplicate votes from one person without naming them; duplicates are rejected, records kept in cedar. Keys mint free, persons do not: N seats need N recruited people, cost linear in recruits, holding while per-seat lifetime reward stays below one person's bribe price.
